readings.moment: When the temple bell struck nine, Aurèle had everyone bring out their watches
When the temple bell struck nine (the witness says his watch was two minutes ahead of the bell)
When he and Madame stopped playing piquet in the salon
A moment after he sat down again, when the hall clock struck eleven

durations: Doctor's watch was two minutes ahead of the temple bell
A moment between sitting down again and the hall clock striking eleven
whereabouts: Dined at the house tonight, at the dinner table where Aurèle gave his dinner
Aurèle went round the table collecting and examining the guests' watches at nine o'clock
Played piquet with Madame in the salon until a quarter to eleven by his watch
Went out to the hall to fetch his cigar case from his coat
Madame began playing the piano in the salon as he went out
Came back, and Madame stopped playing when he came back
Sat down again and lit a cigar
Saw Monnier's body, having brought his bag (time and place of this not stated)
Girard and Aurèle quarrelled over the repeater at table (not stated whether this evening)
